items.title: Positive harmonic conformastatic electrovac data
items.design_state: Full local definition or conditional proof authored with the planned claim, exact mathematical hypotheses, and warnings preserved.
items.statement: Let $D\subseteq\mathbb R^3$ be open and let $H\in C^\infty(D,(0,\infty))$ be independent of time. Write $x=(x^1,x^2,x^3)$ for length coordinates, set $x^0=ct$ when a time variable is used, and require $H$ to be dimensionless. The ordinary Euclidean Laplacian is $\Delta_\delta H:=\sum_{i=1}^3\partial_i^2H$; call $H$ harmonic when $\Delta_\delta H=0$. Take $\mathcal M=\mathbb R_{x^0}\times D$, with orientation $dx^0\wedge dx^1\wedge dx^2\wedge dx^3$ and future direction selected by $N_H=H\partial_{x^0}$.
